data.text:
QC EXPERIENCED ‘ONE WEEK’S WORTH OF RAIN’

PAGASA released a radar observation photo following the severe flooding in Quezon City on Saturday, August 30, 2025.

“The Science Garden Station recorded 134.2 mm of rainfall, which is nearly equivalent to one week’s worth of rain based on the monthly normal of 568.5 mm,” their post on Monday read.

The state weather bureau added that peak rainfall with an intensity of 96.6 to 105.0 mm/hr happened between 2 to 3 PM, which corresponds to a return period of 10-15 years based on the Science Garden rainfall intensity duration frequency (RIDF) curve.

“This indicates that a rainfall event with a 10–15 year return period is sufficient enough to cause flooding in portions of Quezon City,” they added. (X/PAGASA)
